summary: This bill requires the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) to ensure that veterans' appointment scheduling occurs during their initial phone call to a VA medical facility and mandates that VA medical center directors submit annual and quarterly fact sheets on facility status and wait times, while also limiting the duration of director reassignments.
